title: pgoffset is one page too low for every overflow page
bug_query: SELECT pageno, pagetype, pgoffset, (pageno-1)*512 AS expected, pgoffset-(pageno-1)*512 AS delta FROM dbstat ORDER BY pageno;
expected: pgoffset equals (pageno-1)*page_size on every row, so delta is 0
actual: every 'overflow' row reports pgoffset one page_size too low (delta -512)
